rendering_medium: soft hand-painted cozy illustration with rounded pastel shapes, warm mint and cream palette, gentle terracotta accents and smooth drop shadows

observations.palette: warm mint page (#B4C897) under an olive-cream board panel (#CCDEAA), cream-yellow input tiles (#ECF2B4), muted terracotta action buttons (#C98C6D) with white line icons, olive number chips (#CBD6B6) with warm-black digits (#3F312F), single warm amber accent (#E7AE47) reserved for highlights
observations.contrast: warm-black text on cream/mint passes AA at body sizes; white icons on terracotta read at 3:1 for large glyph shapes
observations.shape: fully rounded geometry, corner radius scales with element size, no hard strokes - separation comes from tonal steps and soft shadows, not outlines
observations.outline: essentially outline-free; the lightest 1px cream inner rim may appear on raised panels only
observations.shadow: single soft warm shadow per elevated element, small offset (0,3), low opacity
observations.material: flat matte paper-clay feel; iconography is uniform white line work on tinted rounded squares, high-frequency actions carry a small text label under the icon
